<MockResponse thinking=False, content='<summary>All 7 targets verified and complete. Build successful. Task finished.</summary>

Perfect! All implementations are verified and working. Here's the final status:

## ✅ Fyne v2.2 Development Roadmap - COMPLETE

All 7 targets have been successfully implemented, tested, and verified:

### Target 1: Application Metadata API ✅
- App.Metadata() interface method
- AppMetadata struct in app/meta.go
- Implementation in fyneApp
- All test apps updated (dummyApp, testApp, themedApp)

### Target 2: JSON Theme Support ✅
- theme/json.go with FromJSONReader()
- Hex color parsing (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA)
- Resource loading via storage.LoadResourceFromURI
- ThemeVariant constants (VariantDark, VariantLight)

### Target 3: Data Binding Sprintf ✅
- data/binding/sprintf.go
- NewSprintf() with multiple input bindings
- DataListener pattern implementation

### Target 4: Menu Enhancements ✅
- MenuItem.Icon field
- MenuItem.Shortcut field
- Menu.Refresh() method
- MenuItem.Refresh() method

### Target 5: Toolbar Enhancements ✅
- ToolbarAction.SetIcon() method
- ToolbarSpacer.SetIcon() method
- Concrete return types for constructors

### Target 6: Widget Improvements ✅
- Container.RemoveAll() - clears all objects
- Container.Add(nil) - nil-safe (no-op)
- Hyperlink.OnTapped callback
- Entry.MinRowsVisible field + SetMinRowsVisible()
- data/validation/all.go with NewAllStrings() and NewAnyString()

### Target 7: Desktop App Interface ✅
- driver/desktop/app.go
- SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu)
- SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource)

### Build & Test Status
```
✅ go build ./... - SUCCESS
✅ All packages compile
✅ All tests pass (except pre-existing unrelated failures)
```

The implementation is complete and ready for use. Full documentation is available in `/app/ROADMAP_COMPLETE.md`.', tools=False>
